high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "nowthisnews." The post features a photograph of Pope Francis, who is dressed in his traditional white papal attire, including a white zucchetto (skullcap) and a white cassock. He is smiling and waving with his right hand, which is adorned with a ring on the ring finger. The text overlay on the image reads: "Thanks to God's grace and to the work of many, we now have vaccines to protect us from COVID-19... Getting vaccinated is a simple yet proud way to care for one another, especially the most vulnerable
